title: Evaluating humoral immune responses in mice after SARS-CoV-2 vaccination
author: Zhang, Li, et al.

steps.title: Clone spike gene into pAdApt
steps.instruction: Insert the SARS‑CoV‑2 WA01/2020 spike gene (or EGFP) into the pBR322‑based adaptor plasmid pAdApt using HindIII and EcoRI sites, driven by a CMV promoter and terminated by an SV40 polyA signal.

steps.title: Seed HEK293A cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Day 1: Seed 2.5 × 10⁶ HEK293A cells into each T25 flask and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until 70‑80 % confluence (≈24 h).

steps.title: Digest plasmids with PacI
steps.instruction: Day 2: Digest 2 µg pAdApt and 6 µg pWE plasmids with PacI at 37 °C for 2–3 h; run 2 µL on an agarose gel to confirm complete digestion. Store linearized plasmids at –20 °C (short‑term only).

steps.title: Prepare PEI‑DNA transfection mix
steps.instruction: Dilute the digested plasmids and 24 µg PEI each in 500 µL Opti‑MEM, combine, and incubate at 25 °C for 15 min before adding to the T25 flask.

steps.title: Incubate transfected cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the transfected HEK293A flasks at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 48 h.

steps.title: Scale‑up virus production (T75)
steps.instruction: Day 4: Detach cells with 0.05 % trypsin‑EDTA, transfer from T25 to a T75 flask; monitor for cytopathic effect (CPE) from days 5 to 14.

steps.title: Harvest crude virus culture
steps.instruction: When most cells are rounded/detached but not lysed, scrape cells, collect cells + medium into a 15 mL tube (crude culture). Perform three freeze (–20 °C) / thaw (37 °C) cycles, then centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25 °C. Remove 2 mL supernatant to re‑infect a fresh T75 flask; if no CPE after ~14 days, harvest and repeat freeze‑thaw, then re‑infect. Store crude culture at –80 °C for long‑term.

steps.title: Expand Working Virus Seed Stock (WVSS)
steps.instruction: Day 1: Seed 2 × 10⁷ HEK293A cells into a T175 flask. Day 2: Add 2 mL viral stock to infect (cells at 70‑80 % confluence). Days 4‑6: Monitor CPE, harvest crude culture when full CPE appears, freeze‑thaw three times, centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min, collect ~25 mL supernatant as WVSS. Store WVSS at –80 °C.

steps.title: Bulk virus expansion
steps.instruction: Day 1: Seed HEK293A cells into five 5‑layer T175 flasks. Day 2: Inoculate each flask with 4 mL WVSS (cells at 70‑80 % confluence). Days 4‑6: When complete CPE is observed, collect cells + medium into a 50 mL tube, centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend cells in 19 mL 1× PBS per tube, then freeze at –20 °C. Store at –80 °C for long‑term.

steps.title: Lyse harvested cells
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen production at 37 °C, add 2.25 mL 5 % sodium deoxycholate (DOC) per tube (final 0.5 % DOC), invert 20×, incubate 37 °C for 5 min, invert 20× again.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL 1 M MgCl₂ per tube, invert 20×; add 80 µL 10 mg/mL DNase, invert 20×; incubate 37 °C for 15 min; invert 20×; centrifuge at 12,000 g for 30 min, pour off supernatant into new tubes.

steps.title: CsCl block gradient purification
steps.instruction: Prepare ultracentrifuge tubes with 10 mL 1.24 g/mL CsCl, layer 5 mL 1.4 g/mL CsCl at the bottom, then add 23–25 mL viral supernatant. Balance tubes to 0.01 g, ultracentrifuge at 21,000 rpm (58,400 g) for 2 h at 10 °C (AH‑629 rotor). Extract the visible virus band (between 1.24 and 1.4 g/mL) with a 0.9–40 mm needle and 10 mL syringe into a new tube.

steps.title: CsCl continuous gradient purification
steps.instruction: Transfer collected virus into 13.2 mL ultracentrifuge tubes (≤7 mL per tube), add 1.33 g/mL CsCl, balance, ultracentrifuge at 55,000 rpm (260,000 g) for 10–18 h at 4 °C (TH‑641 rotor). Extract the middle virus band with a needle and syringe, minimizing volume.

steps.title: Dialyze purified virus
steps.instruction: Prepare dialysis buffers 1, 2, 3. In a 3 L beaker with stir bar, add 1.5 L buffer 1. Place the CsCl‑virus mixture in a 10 kDa cutoff dialysis membrane (3–15 mL capacity), secure with clips, and dialyze at 200 rpm, 25 °C for 1 h. Replace with buffer 2 for another hour, then buffer 3 for a final hour. Transfer virus to a 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Aliquot and store virus
steps.instruction: Dispense appropriate volumes of purified virus into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and store at –80 °C for long‑term.

steps.title: Quantify viral particles by qPCR
steps.instruction: Use primer pair pAdapt‑PF / pAdapt‑PR to perform quantitative PCR and determine viral particle (vp) titers.

steps.title: Validate virus infectivity
steps.instruction: Infect A549 cells with purified adenovirus at 5 MOI; after 48 h observe EGFP fluorescence and confirm spike protein expression by Western blot.

steps.title: Maintain and allocate mice
steps.instruction: House specific‑pathogen‑free 6‑ to 8‑week‑old BALB/c mice (5 per cage) in the animal care facility.

steps.title: Immunize mice intramuscularly
steps.instruction: Inject each mouse with 1 × 10⁸ vp adenoviral vaccine in 100 µL total volume, split bilaterally into the quadriceps (avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles).

steps.title: Collect plasma four weeks later
steps.instruction: Four weeks post‑vaccination, obtain 100–200 µL peripheral blood via submandibular bleed, centrifuge at 1,000 g for 10 min at 25 °C, and collect plasma; store at –80 °C if not used immediately.

steps.title: Clone RBD into pcDNA3.1
steps.instruction: Synthesize codon‑optimized SARS‑CoV‑2 RBD DNA, subclone into pcDNA3.1 with a C‑terminal 6×His tag using HindIII and EcoRI sites.

steps.title: Seed HEK‑293F cells for protein expression
steps.instruction: Seed HEK‑293F cells at 0.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL in 400 mL CD 293 TGE medium in a 1 L shaker flask; incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 150 rpm, 5 % CO₂ until density reaches 2.0 × 10⁶ cells/mL with 95‑98 % viability.

steps.title: Transfect HEK‑293F cells
steps.instruction: Dilute 400 µg filter‑sterilized RBD plasmid in 20 mL CD 293 TGE medium, vortex 5 s; add 1.2 mL 1 mg/mL PEI, vortex 5 s, incubate 25 °C for 20 min; add mixture to the 400 mL cell culture and incubate 5 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 150 rpm.

steps.title: Harvest and filter culture supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 12,000 g for 15 min, filter the supernatant through a 0.22 µm filter.

steps.title: Purify RBD by His‑Trap chromatography
steps.instruction: Adjust supernatant pH to 7.4 with 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 8). Load onto a His GraviTrap column on ice using a peristaltic pump. Wash with 50 column volumes of 1× PBS + 20 mM imidazole. Elute sequentially with 2 column volumes of 1× PBS containing 100 mM, 200 mM, then 300 mM imidazole.

steps.title: Buffer exchange and concentrate protein
steps.instruction: Collect high‑purity fractions, exchange buffer to 1× PBS using a 10 kDa Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter, concentrate, and store the purified RBD at –80 °C.
